evidence.document: Texas Instruments SO20W exact marking and package review

marking.appearance_status: Texas Instruments lists TPIC6B595 as the package marking. Typeface, orientation, placement and variable lot/date details are illustrative.

recipe.appearance_status: Illustrative KiCad SOIC-20W model; the 2.75 mm source model is scaled vertically to the Texas Instruments 2.65 mm maximum height as a display-only approximation. Catalogue lists 10 x 5 mm without width reference, height or footprint, inconsistent with TI nominal 12.8 x 7.5 mm body. Not a verified mechanical model. Typeface and placement are illustrative.

studio.note: Electronics adaptation of the screw product studio: three softboxes, orthographic framing, neutral floor and filmic highlights. Does not claim identical Blender AgX colour management.
